name: CSO_USER_ATTRIBUTES
description: This table contains the properties of individual users.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Fusion apps identifier for this user.

columns.name: ALIAS
columns.description: This is the user alias field for this record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the date that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the date that the record was modified.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DEFAULT_SUB_SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the default View for a user.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: The locale associated with the current record.

columns.name: LOOKUP_CODE_ID
columns.description: Deprecated. Reference to LOOKUP_CODE table. Contains the user preference for format of eMails sent. Valid values are AOL, HTML, and plain text.

columns.name: OWNER_SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID for the repository or view the user belongs to

columns.name: PDIT_CHALLENGE
columns.description: This is the PDIT challenge used in standalone PDIT environments.

columns.name: OLD_RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the old-style GUID record ID that was associated with this user.

columns.name: RECEIVE_PERFORM
columns.description: Flag indicating if user should receive email notifications for tasks they can perform

columns.name: RECEIVE_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Flag indicating if user should receive email notifications for tasks they have been assigned.

columns.name: REPUTATION_POINTS
columns.description: Reputation Points for this user.

columns.name: USER_LEVEL
columns.description: This is the GUID for the reputation model the user belongs to

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULE
columns.description: The subscription schedule this user is on.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: This is the comment for the column EXTERNAL_ID.

columns.name: TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE_ID
columns.description: With the introduction of integration users, we want a strongly typed column (lookup code ID) do determine which type the user is (console, web, or integration).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
